ChessZero uses the standard Gradle Wrapper execution model.

Pinned distribution:
  Gradle 8.7
  SHA-256: 544c35d6bd849ae8a5ed0bcea39ba677dc40f49df7d1835561582da2009b961d

The checked-in gradle-wrapper.jar is the official Gradle 8.7 Wrapper JAR.
The launcher scripts delegate to org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain; they do
not download or unpack Gradle themselves.
